Ct. App. D. C. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pau-peris denied. Petitioners are allowed until June 11, 2012, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to *1009submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
